clean.title: Interchange Design Promptlist (FHWA Missouri Division, Page 1 of 14)
clean.summary: First page of the FHWA Missouri Division prompt-list for assessing key geometric features of new or reconstructed interchanges, printed from the FHWA web page. It has the project header fields, Section 1.0 on applicable design standards and the 13 controlling criteria, and Section 2.0 questions on interchange spacing (1 mile) and ramp spacing against AASHTO criteria.
clean.notes:
1.0 Design Standards
1.1 What design standards are applicable to the project
_____ AASHTO publication "A Policy on Design Standards Interstate System" - applicable for all projects on the Interstate System
_____ AASHTO publication "A Policy on Geometric Design of Highways and Streets" (commonly called the Green Book) - applicable to all freeways on the NHS including the Interstate System
_____ Additional standards of State DOT for geometric design, standard drawings, and standard specifications that meet or exceed the FHWA's adopted standards
1.2 Any design exceptions to the "13 controlling criteria" proposed? __________
2.0 Interchange and Ramp Spacing
2.1 Does the interchange spacing (based on crossroad to crossroad spacing) exceed 1 mi? __________
2.2 Does the spacing between successive entrances and exits meet or exceed AASHTO criteria? __________
3.0 Approach Alignment to Interchange (heading only, continues on the next page).
The form continues on following pages (14 pages in total).
clean.description:
Printed web page (page 1 of 14) from the FHWA Missouri Division website, highways.dot.gov/field-offices/missouri/interchange-design-promptlist, printed 7/23/2026 6:36 PM. The top shows the official US government website banner, the United States Department of Transportation link, a Search box, the breadcrumb Home / Field Offices / Missouri, and an In This Section box with a Contact Us panel: Missouri Division, Federal Highway Administration, 3220 W. Edgewood, Suite H, Jefferson City, MO 65109, United States, Phone (573) 636-7104, Fax (573) 636-9283, and the line that people who are deaf, hard of hearing, or have a speech disability should dial 7-1-1 for telecommunications relay services.

Below that is the heading Interchange Design Promptlist with a link to interchange_design_promptlist.pdf (186.42 KB). The start of the form follows, titled Interchange Design (New Construction and Reconstruction) Prompt-List for Assessing Key Geometric Features, with blank fields for Project, Location, Description, Assessment made by, and Date of Assessment.

Section 1.0 Design Standards: 1.1 asks what design standards are applicable to the project, with three checkbox lines. Section 1.2 asks about design exceptions. Section 2.0 Interchange and Ramp Spacing has questions 2.1 and 2.2 with blank answer lines. The page ends at the heading 3.0 Approach Alignment to Interchange, which continues on the next page.
